subject: db-sql content bugs: unvacuumable tables, no-op GRANT, \q kills session
description: Found+verified live by SBX-7 db-sql authoring agent 2026-07-10: (1) db-32 PG-04 'VACUUM ANALYZE employees' fails for every student — WARNING permission denied (PG16, tables owned by postgres, student lacks MAINTAIN); fix image: GRANT MAINTAIN ON ALL TABLES or reassign ownership, then badge check can pin employees. (2) db-27 PG-03 GRANT SELECT..TO auditor emits 'no privileges were granted' (student holds SELECT w/o GRANT OPTION) — has_table_privilege stays f; fix grants WITH GRANT OPTION in entrypoint or reword exercise. (3) db-27 PG-04 instructs \q-then-bash but psql IS the ttyd process — \q kills the session; pg_dump only reachable via \!; fix lab text. (4) db-32 PG-03 '\! sudo -u postgres' fails, student has no sudoers entry. Sibling bugs: #88 (do-16), #89 (do-100/102).
